blocks.text: Is chapter ne dikhaya ke Python programs classes aur objects se kaise ban sakte hain, aur encapsulation, inheritance aur polymorphism unhein kaise zyada mehfooz, dobara qabil-e-istemal aur lachakdar banate hain. Table is ki bunyadi istilahat ikatthi karti hai.

blocks.caption: Chapter 3 ki kaleedi istilahat
rows: Program ko haqeeqi cheezon ki numaindagi karne wale objects se design karna
Objects ka naqsha ya saancha jo un ki sifaat aur rawaiye tay karta hai
Class ka instance: apne data aur functions wali haqeeqi cheez
Program ko chhote hisson mein baantna jo alag alag banaye aur sambhale ja sakein
Pehle se likha code program ke doosre hisson ya doosre programs mein dobara use karna
Data aur us ke methods class mein ikatthe rakhna aur data ko be-ijazat rasai se bachana
Aik class ka doosri class ki sifaat aur methods use karna
Aik hi method ya amal ka object ke mutabiq mukhtalif kaam karna

items: Classes aur objects haqeeqi cheezon ka model banate.
Encapsulation data bachati; inheritance code dobara use aur wasee karti; polymorphism aik interface ko kai shaklein deti.
